fusions.name: Curled Plummet
fusions.desc: Curls and drops, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Shed Scale
fusions.desc: Flicks a loose scale that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Shingled Coat
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds and your dodge chance by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Folded Pinions
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
